takeaways: A Teams Phone migration is a routing, identity and emergency-safety project, so start with a number-to-purpose register built from call records and named owners.
Calling Plans, Operator Connect and Direct Routing differ mainly in who carries the operational risk, and many tenants combine them by country and requirement.
Porting, emergency calling and the contact center need their own timelines, tests and owners, and cutover needs a written rollback trigger and one accountable voice owner.
hook: Most Teams Phone migrations fail not because of Microsoft but because of assumptions the old PBX hid for years. This episode walks IT leaders and voice admins through discovery, connectivity models, porting, emergency calling, SBC design and cutover. You will learn how to move from a PBX to cloud calling without surprises on Monday morning.
